Encouraging Growth One Step at a Time
Skip Mitchell, life coach
Making changes can be challenging, especially
if we cannot see a clear
path forward・A mentor, who mav be a tutor at school or a boss at work, can
help.
Mentors are those who advise or train others, and one method they may
use is the GROW model.
This model focuses more on asking learners questions
regarding their goals rather than simply telling them what to do
One reason
the GROW model is so effective is that it simplifies complex goals into smaller
processes through four steps.
The first step in the GROW model is Goal・This is about clearly defining
the desired outcome.
A clear goal
is important because
it helps the learner
stay focused and motivated.
It also means that the learner and mentor will
have the same outcome in mind throughout the process.
Next, the
RealitV step asks the
learner to think about their current
situation.
By renecting on their present circumstances, the learner can see the
gap between their current position and their goa1.
As a result, they can have
realistic expectations about what is possible.
In the Options step, the learner thinks of different ways to reach their goal.
In turn, the mentor helps them to consider a variety of challenges they could
face with each potential solution.
This gives the learner a greater sense of
control over the process.
Finally, the Will step focuses on selecting a plan of action.
This includes
what the learner will do, when they will do it, and how they remain invested in
it.
The mentor can help to determine deadlines and consider how to keep the
learner motivated.
Overall, the GROW model provides a simple yet effective way fbr learners
to break down their goals into clear actions.
As a result, they can be successful
in both their personal and professional lives.
